style_fidelity.content_policy: Three unrelated, Lantai-owned content sets use one style profile with different compositions.
checks: consistent style DNA without coordinate reuse
native editable text, shape, number, chart where applicable
actual PPTX render and full-deck montage review

style_generalization.content_policy: Comparable content is generated through the same planner, compiler, critic, and repair stack.
checks: profiles differ in composition language, not only palette
identity constraints remain hard where required
weak layout traits are optimized in brand-preserve mode
tiny type, stretched images, card spam, uncontrolled color, bevel, and heavy shadow are rejected
